summary: The note defines the Second United Front, the alliance between the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Communist Party of China (CPC) formed to resist the Japanese invasion. The alliance operated during the Second Sino-Japanese War and suspended the Chinese Civil War from 1937 to 1941.
one_line: The Second United Front was the KMT-CPC alliance against Japanese invasion during the Second Sino-Japanese War, which paused the Chinese Civil War from 1937 to 1941.
key_facts: The Second United Front was an alliance between the Chinese Nationalist Party (Kuomintang, or KMT) and the Communist Party of China (CPC).
The alliance was formed to resist the Japanese invasion during the Second Sino-Japanese War.
The Second United Front suspended the Chinese Civil War from 1937 to 1941.
